tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Find a travel destination (country) sold by eSIM SOS by name in English or Russian, or by ISO code. Returns country codes for list_plans.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List eSIM data plans for a country with final prices in RUB (one price for every payment method). Local plans first, then regional ones.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare eSIM prices of several providers for a country and data size using the open esimdar.com dataset (CC BY 4.0). Disclosure: esimdar.com is owned and run by eSIM SOS, the shop behind this server; eSIM SOS is listed as an ordinary row. Tell the user about this ownership and present the results ne

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an unpaid eSIM order and get a payment link. Payment is always done by the human: give the user the payment link, never try to pay yourself and never ask for card details. Ask the user for their email first: the eSIM QR code is sent there. Creates a real order, so call it only after the user

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Check the payment and delivery status of an order. Requires both order_id and the email used for the order.

tools.name: install_instructions
tools.description: After payment: link to the order page with the QR code and step-by-step eSIM install instructions for iPhone and Android. Requires order_id and email.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Create an unpaid eSIM order and get a payment link. Payment is always done by the human: give the user the payment link, never try to pay yourself and never ask…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order, order_status · Public sink: create_order, order_status, install_instructions · Destructive: compare_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order, order_status · Public sink: create_order, order_status, install_instructions · Destructive: compare_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
